# Community Rule Column 2 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 2

---

**2:1** "May He bless you with every good thing and protect you from every evil;
**2:2** may He fill your mind with life-giving understanding and favor you with eternal knowledge;
**2:3** may He turn His loving face toward you and grant you unending peace."
**2:4** Then the Levites shall pronounce a curse on all who belong to Belial's company; they shall declare:
**2:5** "You are cursed in all your guilty and wicked deeds! May God hand you over
**2:6** to terror through all who carry out vengeance! May He unleash destruction upon you
**2:7** through all who deal out retribution! You are cursed beyond all mercy,
**2:8** in keeping with the darkness of what you have done, and condemned
**2:9** to the shadow of unending fire! May God refuse you grace when you cry out, and may He never pardon you
**2:10** or purge your guilt! May He turn His furious face against you in judgment, and may you never find
**2:11** peace — not even from those who champion the ancestors!" After both the blessing and the curse,
**2:12** everyone entering the covenant shall say: "Amen, amen!"
**2:13** The priests and the Levites shall go on to say: "A curse upon anyone who enters
**2:14** this covenant while setting up the obstacles of his own sin before himself, intending to stumble back into them.
**2:15** When such a person hears the terms of this covenant, he reassures himself, thinking: 'Everything will be fine for me,
**2:16** even though I persist in my own stubborn ways.' But his very life will be destroyed — the drought-stricken
**2:17** swept away along with the well-watered — and no forgiveness will come. The fury of God and the passion of His justice
**2:18** will blaze against him in everlasting ruin; every curse written in this covenant will fasten itself
**2:19** to him. God will single him out for disaster, and he will be expelled from among all the Children of Light,
**2:20** because he turned away from God through his false devotions and the obstacle of his wrongdoing. His fate will be cast
**2:21** among those who are cursed forever. Everyone entering the covenant shall respond
**2:22** and say after them: "Amen, amen!"
**2:23** This ceremony shall be repeated every year throughout the entire era of Belial's dominion. The priests shall proceed
**2:24** first in rank, arranged by their spiritual standing, one after another; the Levites shall follow
**2:25** after them; then all the people shall proceed in third place, one after another, organized by thousands,
**2:26** hundreds, fifties, and tens, so that every person in Israel knows their proper place in God's community, established for the eternal assembly. No one shall drop below their position or rise above their assigned rank.

---
*PNEUMA notes: The priestly blessing (2:1-3) is rendered to highlight its warmth and intimacy, echoing the Aaronic benediction. The curse formula (2:5-10) conveys its severity in accessible English. "The parched together with the watered" (2:16-17) is an ancient merism meaning "everything without exception" — rendered here to preserve that totality. The self-deceiver in 2:15 echoes Deuteronomy 29:19. The military-style organization (thousands, hundreds, fifties, tens) in 2:25-26 reflects Israel's wilderness camp structure.*
